description: Create a new user label in one mailbox and return its id and name, ready for modify_labels. Use it when the user wants mail filed under a label that list_labels does not show yet. A "/" makes a nested label, e.g. "Projects/Acme". Fails if a label with that name already exists. Only for accounts connected with --labels.

account.description: Which mailbox: email address, alias, or local part. Optional when only one account is connected.

name.description: The new label's name; "/" nests it under a parent.

name: create_label
title: Create a label
